content: विरोधः .²1 Opposition, obstruction, impediment. .²2 Blockade, siege, investment. .²3 Restraint, check. .²4 Inconsistency, incongruity, contradiction; विरोधो न विद्यते ब्रह्माद्वितीयमेव सत्यम् . (--<ls>tripādvibhūtimahānārāyaṇopaniṣat 4. 2.</ls>) .²5 Antithesis, contrast. .²6 Enmity, hostility; विरोधो विश्रान्तः <ls>U. 6. 11</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 332</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 13</ls>. .²7 A quarrel, disagreement. .²8 A calamity, misfortune. .²9 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) An apparent incongruity which is merely verbal and is explained away by properly construing the passage; it consists in representing objects as antithetical to one another though in the nature of things they are not so; representing things as being together though really they cannot be together; (this figure is largely used by Bāṇa and Subandhu; पुष्पवत्यपि पवित्रा, कृष्णोऽप्यसुदर्शनः, भरतोऽपि शत्रुघ्नः being familiar instances); it is thus defined by Mammaṭa:-- विरोधः सोऽविरोधेऽपि विरुद्धत्वने यद्वचः <ls>K. P. 10</ls>; (this figure is also called विरोधाभास).
